title: Fluxid Workflow History
description: History log of workflow events across multiple phases. Append-only log written by external agents, read by fluxid workflow controller to prevent repeating failed approaches.

status.description: Outcome of workflow step. SUCCESS indicates completed successfully, FAIL indicates retry needed.

examples: Initial implementation attempted using channels for file notification
Successfully implemented file-based report reading with direct file I/O

details.description: Detailed approach and failure reason. RECOMMENDED for FAIL status to prevent repeating mistakes. Optional for SUCCESS status.
examples: Tried implementing file change watcher using Go channels and fsnotify. Failed because requirements specify strictly sequential workflow with no concurrency. Channels introduce async behavior incompatible with constitution principle III.
Removed all async operations. Workflow calls storage.ReadReport() synchronously after agent exits. Simple file read with error handling. Passes constitution check.

examples.summary: Initial implementation attempted using channels for file notification
examples.details: Tried implementing file change watcher using Go channels and fsnotify. Failed because requirements specify strictly sequential workflow with no concurrency. Channels introduce async behavior incompatible with constitution principle III.

examples.summary: Second attempt using file polling with goroutines
examples.details: Attempted file polling with background goroutines to check report file existence. Failed review because goroutines violate sequential workflow requirement. Constitution check rejected parallel operations.

examples.summary: Successfully implemented file-based report reading with direct file I/O
examples.details: Removed all async operations. Workflow calls storage.ReadReport() synchronously after agent exits. Simple file read with error handling. Passes constitution check.

examples.summary: Review passed with minor concerns addressed
